In normal cells, FOXO4 retains p53 in the nucleus preventing apoptosis — a mechanism senescent cells exploit for survival. FOXO4-DRI competitively binds FOXO4, freeing p53 to migrate to mitochondria, triggering apoptosis selectively in senescent cells. Results in clearance of senescent cell burden, reduction of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), and tissue rejuvenation markers in aged mice.
